name: Betrayal from Within
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Take Lok's head to Thork in the Crossroads, friend. <snort> He should know what has happened to my tribe without any words--ha, not that he would believe Mangletooth helped in <snort> such things. But I am sure he'll reward you for carrying out such a great deed. <snort>

I will continue to bless you with Agamaggan's power for as long as I remain in this cage, friend. Until then, farewell.
narrative.objectives: Bring Lok's Skull to Thork at the Crossroads in the Barrens.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You found the Razormane leader and killed him yourself, adventurer? Amazing.

I am without words, but that does not mean I am without thanks. The people of the Crossroads would do well to respect your strength.

I must admit, I thought the leader of these raids on our supply lines was another quilboar. Thank you again, adventurer.

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 21 to 25, 7,450 XP in all.

quests.name: Tribes at War
quests.objectiveText: Kill 6 Bristleback Water Seekers, 12 Bristleback Thornweavers and 12 Bristleback Geomancers and return to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.

quests.name: Blood Shards of Agamaggan
quests.objectiveText: Bring a Blood Shard to Mangletooth in Camp Taurajo in the Barrens. Collect more Blood Shards if you want him to bless you with Agamaggan's power.

quests.name: Betrayal from Within
quests.objectiveText: Kill Nak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane and bring their skulls to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.

quests.name: Betrayal from Within
quests.objectiveText: Bring Lok's Skull to Thork at the Crossroads in the Barrens.
